text:
Samir Patel: Heads-up from procurement at NexaThera — they say this month's invoice double-charged the platform fee after their Oct license migration. Can someone confirm? @LenaOrtiz @DiegoRamos

Lena Ortiz: Oof. I see INV-2026-0452 in the portal. Customer notes both "Platform Fee (Committed) $22,000" and "Platform Fee (Private License) $22,000" — same period. PDF attached but portal link for quick check: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0452

Support Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2026-0452 generated by billing-pipeline v3.2.4. Automated check flagged: duplicate product code on same billing period.

Diego Ramos: They migrated from a hosted to a private license on 2026-10-05 and signed amendment AMND-889. Migration should have pro-rated platform fee for partial month and not charge both SKUs. Looks like a join condition failed between license_history and invoice_items.

Samir Patel: Can you paste line items? Procurement needs a quick figure so they can approve PO.

Lena Ortiz: Pasted from invoice:
```
Invoice INV-2026-0452
Customer: NexaThera Ltd
Period: 2026-11-01 - 2026-11-30
Line items:
 - Platform Fee (Committed): $22,000
 - Reserved Capacity (GPUs): $60,000
 - Platform Fee (Private License): $22,000
 - Overages (compute): $3,250
 - Support (Enterprise): $13,500
Total: $120,750
```

Samir Patel: If one of those platform fee lines is wrong we need amount to credit. Which one is the correct one to keep?

Diego Ramos: Contract AMND-889 states private license replaces hosted committed package starting 2026-11-01; platform fee should be a single $22,000. Migration pro-rate was handled last month. So the duplicate is an error — remove the duplicate line. Credit amount = $22,000. However overages were valid per monitoring — keep $3,250. Net credit = $22,000.

Support Billing Bot: Creating ticket BILL-9942: "duplicate platform fee on renewal after license migration".

Sales Ops: Looping in customer success. Procurement flagged this as urgent because PO approver needs cleared invoice to release funds. They asked for a corrected invoice + short explanation.

Samir Patel: Legal prefers neutral language. Draft reply: "We identified an inconsistency on invoice INV-2026-0452 and have issued a credit memo to correct it. A revised invoice will be sent within 48 hours." Thoughts?

Lena Ortiz: Sounds good. Add contact: "For procurement questions please contact me (Lena) or Samir."

Diego Ramos: I'll open a billing bug for the join condition and add a unit test to ensure license_history and active_subscriptions dedupe by product_code at invoice time. Ticket: BILL-9942 assigned to eng-billing. ETA 3 business days for patch.

Support Billing Bot: BILL-9942 assigned to eng-billing. Status: in progress.

Samir Patel: Finance needs the credit memo number and the reissued invoice ID for the procurement team. Can Finance Ops prepare and publish?

Finance Ops: Preparing credit memo. Will need confirmation of the net credit amount and the reissued invoice lines. Please confirm final numbers.

Lena Ortiz: Confirmed: credit $22,000 to remove duplicate platform fee. Reissued invoice should read:
 - Platform Fee (Private License): $22,000
 - Reserved Capacity (GPUs): $60,000
 - Overages (compute): $3,250
 - Support (Enterprise): $13,500
Total corrected invoice: $98,750

Samir Patel: Approved. Proceed with credit memo and corrected invoice. Use credit memo template and keep wording neutral.

Support Billing Bot: Credit memo CM-2026-061 created (placeholder) pending final approval.

Finance Ops: Created CM-2026-061 for $22,000. Reissued invoice INV-2026-0452R with corrected total $98,750. Uploaded both docs to customer portal and emailed procurement contact with the neutral explanation.

Sales Ops: Procurement confirmed they received corrected invoice and will proceed with internal approval. They requested an email thread showing the correction for their audit; we provided the portal links + CM.

Diego Ramos: Patch PR opened to prevent duplicate platform fee: billing-pipeline#1307. Unit tests added.

Support Billing Bot: BILL-9942 status: fix merged to staging; deploy scheduled.

Samir Patel: Thanks team. Finance Ops, confirm journal entries when posted and then close.

Finance Ops: Journal entries posted, credit applied to customer account, and revenue true-up completed. Marking thread resolved.

Support Billing Bot: INV-2026-0452 status: corrected (INV-2026-0452R). CM-2026-061 applied. BILL-9942 closed after deploy."
